name: petty
description: Your Petty drawers as tools: find an item, balances and counts, history, add or take.
long_description: Petty is an end-to-end encrypted record of the money, things and notes you keep at home. This add-on runs on your own computer. It holds your access token, opens your drawer keys here, and talks to your Petty server, which only ever sees ciphertext. Make a token in Petty: Settings → Access tokens.

api_url.title: Petty address
api_url.description: Your Petty's API address, shown next to the token in Settings. For example https://petty.example.com/api

token.title: Access token
token.description: The token from Settings → Access tokens. It starts with petty_pat_.
